subject: Request: ID & Access evidence pack and next-step timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: ID & Access items from today's call

Elena — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call highlights:
- HealthLytics will evaluate Redwood for chat/summary features in the clinician portal (pilot scope ~5k users).
- Primary compliance asks: SOC 2 status, HIPAA posture, GDPR data residency options, and detailed IAM controls (SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, admin audit trails).
- You requested a starter evidence packet and the vendor security questionnaire to begin internal review.

Proposed next steps:
1) I can send an ID & Access focused evidence packet (SSO setup guide + SCIM example + admin RBAC doc) by end of day today.
2) Please share your security questionnaire (if you have a template) or confirm we should use the spreadsheet you mentioned.
3) Suggest a technical sync next week with your Infra/Security leads — please propose two 30-min slots.

Deliverables timeline:
- Evidence pack (initial): EOD Thu (today) — attachment will include SAML config example and RBAC matrix.
- Follow-up tech sync: target week of Jul 20th.

If that works, I'll attach the first pass and include a short answers matrix for the questionnaire to speed review.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sso_faq.pdf (overview), saml-config-example.yaml (sample metadata)

From: Elena Park <elena@healthlytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@healthlytics.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:07:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: ID & Access items from today's call

Marcus — appreciated. This matches our notes. A few items from security side:

1) We have a standard vendor security questionnaire (attached) that covers SOC 2, incident response, and specific IAM control questions. Please return the completed spreadsheet where possible; we accept partial answers and evidence links.
2) For SSO, we need: SP metadata, SAML certificates, and a short doc that explains how you handle certificate rotation.
3) For provisioning, please include a SCIM sample and the attributes you provision by default (email, name, role, groups).
4) RBAC: a matrix showing admin vs. org-level permissions and whether those can be delegated.

I've attached: healthlytics_vendor_q_v1.xlsx. I'm adding our security lead (security@healthlytics.com) to the thread. Can you confirm the earliest date you can share the items?

Best,
Elena Park
Dir, Product Security — HealthLytics
elena@healthlytics.com

Attachments: healthlytics_vendor_q_v1.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 12:05:34 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: ID & Access items from today's call

Looping in Monica since she owns our evidence pack and SOC 2 artifacts. Quick checklist for what we should return to HealthLytics: 

- Completed vendor spreadsheet (answer where possible, flag items that require legal/security review).
- SSO bundle: SP metadata XML, ACS/EntityID, example saml-config YAML (use saml-config-example.yaml), cert rotation doc (one-pager).
- SCIM: example payloads and the attribute map (include groups support and rate limits).
- RBAC: current admin roles matrix + how org-owner delegation is handled.
- Audit logs: short note describing retention windows and where audit exports live (link to internal runbook).
- SOC 2: latest Type II PDF and scope statement. Monica — can you confirm availability to pull SOC 2 PDF and an excerpt of the controls mapping?

Marcus — I recommend we pre-fill as much of the spreadsheet as we can and mark any items that need legal sign-off. Target to send the initial pack tomorrow morning so HealthLytics can start intake review.

Thanks,
Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

- Completed vendor_q spreadsheet (partial answers + notes) — attached.
